review_question: Can the Cognitive Micro-Lab preserve exact upstream source identity and simulation-only epistemics even when caller-controlled objects try to self-attest or cross-bind unrelated projections?
threats: A direct-constructed or subclassed QuboProjection may carry a self-consistent digest without proving it was admitted against the exact WorldSlice.
A direct-constructed PhysicsProjection may carry caller-chosen slice/source fields and a self-consistent digest without proving exact source replay.
A QUBO projection and physics projection from different cycle/generation/slice identities may be combined into one apparently coherent lab result unless the lab enforces one exact experiment frame.
A perturbation may touch a tainted/NOT_COMPUTED source or silently reconstruct UNKNOWN state through a downstream projection.
A simulated/counterfactual result may accidentally be represented as OBSERVED, verified outcome, action choice, completion evidence or effect authority.
A generic callback/eval/tool hook could turn the Micro-Lab from a bounded deterministic projection harness into an unbounded execution path.

preregistered_acceptance_cases.requirement: For every consumed QuboProjection, require exact QuboProjection and exact WorldSlice identity and pass through the canonical WP402 consumer-side independent revalidation path (score_assignment or a strictly stronger equivalent) with the expected projection digest; self-hash alone is insufficient.

For every consumed PhysicsProjection, require exact bound WorldSlice plus exact position/velocity/acceleration WorldAtoms and validate through validate_physics_projection_binding or a strictly stronger independent replay; self-hash alone is insufficient.
Reject baseline/perturbation inputs whose cycle_id, generation, vector_space_version, slice identity or exact source digest bindings do not belong to the same declared Micro-Lab frame.
Generation 1 must accept only one explicit bounded caller-supplied perturbation per trial and must not discover, infer or execute additional interventions.

Reject or preserve as unresolved any perturbation/projection that depends on tainted NOT_COMPUTED inputs; UNKNOWN/CONFLICT may not be upgraded to KNOWN merely because a simulated branch yields a value.

Every Micro-Lab result must remain candidate/simulated measurement only with truth_authority=NONE, effect_authority=NONE and completion_authority=NONE; no API may return an OBSERVED/VERIFIED state solely from a lab trial.
The canonical source must not accept arbitrary callables, eval/exec strings, shell commands, provider/model/tool handles or dynamic import hooks as perturbations or evaluators.
The same exact source-bound baseline, perturbation and explicit coefficients/parameters must produce byte-equivalent canonical result JSON and digest.

counterhypothesis: The active WP404 implementation may satisfy these requirements directly by composing the already-hardened WP402 and WP403 public validation boundaries and by keeping the lab result schema simulation-only. If so, this packet should become a passing regression contract rather than force a successor generation.
smallest_repair_if_falsified: Repair only the specific consumer boundary in the sole WP404 mutation lane: bind exact source objects, independently revalidate upstream projections, reject cross-frame inputs and keep result authority fields mechanically NONE. Do not redesign WP400/WP402/WP403 or add a second world/effect authority.
next_exact_action: The sole WP404 mutation authority should absorb these cases into tests or prove a strictly stronger equivalent, run exact-head repository-hosted CI, and reconcile only at bounded component scope if all cases fail closed/pass as intended.
